title: An Se Young Claims 11th Title at Korea Open
indian_angle: While no Indian players reached the finals, An Se Young's dominant performance sets a high benchmark for Indian shuttlers aspiring to international glory.
summary: Korean sensation An Se Young defeated Japan's Akane Yamaguchi in a thrilling three-game final to clinch her 11th title of the year at the Korea Open.

title: An Se Young's Unprecedented Reign: A Benchmark for Indian Badminton
indian_angle: An Se Young's record-equalling 11th title highlights the consistent excellence Indian players must strive for to compete at the sport's pinnacle.
summary: With her latest Korea Open victory, An Se Young has equalled the all-time calendar year record for titles, showcasing a level of dominance that Indian badminton players will need to study and emulate.

title: Where Do Indian Shuttlers Stand Against Global Dominance?
indian_angle: This piece reflects on the current state of Indian badminton in light of international powerhouses like An Se Young, discussing strategies for Indian players to close the gap.
summary: As international stars like An Se Young continue to set new benchmarks, an analysis of Indian shuttlers' progress and the challenges they face in reaching the top tier of global badminton.
